analyzed_source: src/metal_infer/engine.c (working tree used for the r5 collection; scalar decode path)
method: static read of every waitUntilCompleted on the decode critical path and the CPU consumers of each GPU-written buffer

cpu_consumers: normed for compressor/indexer state (future tokens only) and re-uploads (engine.c:5199-5206, 5756, 5596)
attention_cb.ownership_transfer: replace CPU truncate+upload with a GPU kernel writing buf_mhc_attn_out_bf16 directly; merged_cb and cb2cmd2 are same-queue, so in-queue ordering transfers ownership without any CPU wait; compressor/indexer outputs have no same-token consumer (comp state is for future tokens; comp_allowed is dead) and can be double-buffered or deferred

cpu_consumers: routing scores / gpu_route_selected readback feeding CPU expert selection and pread dispatch (engine.c:5442, 5523-5560) — inherent to the CPU-managed expert-cache design
residual/ffn_input/post_ffn/comb_ffn/normed readbacks (engine.c:5413-5423) that exist only because cb3 inputs are CPU-uploaded (engine.c:6041-6044)
cb2cmd2_cb.first_later_consumer: CPU expert selection consuming buf_routing_scores/buf_gpu_route_selected (engine.c:5442, 5523-5529); the remaining buffers' first later consumers are GPU encoders (shared-expert CB and cb3)
cb2cmd2_cb.ownership_transfer: keep buf_residual_gpu/buf_mhc_ffn_in/buf_mhc_post/comb_weights GPU-resident through cb3 (removes all non-routing readbacks); the routing readback stays until expert residency moves GPU-side

cpu_consumers: bdown_overlap = [bdown contents] (engine.c:5868) then scalar ffn_out[j] += bdown_overlap[j] (engine.c:5981-5983)
shared_expert_cb.first_later_consumer: the CPU scalar add into ffn_out, which then feeds cb3 via upload
shared_expert_cb.ownership_transfer: fuse the shared-expert add into the routed-MoE moe_combine or into cb3 as a GPU kernel (all operands GPU-resident), eliminating the wait and the CPU add

cpu_consumers: memcpy(ffn_out, [buf_hidden contents]) (engine.c:5978) followed by re-upload to buf_ffn_out_f32 (engine.c:6041)
routed_moe_cb.ownership_transfer: with a GPU-side shared-expert add, buf_hidden feeds cb3 directly — a full GPU→GPU chain with no CPU wait or round trip

cpu_consumers: residual readback (engine.c:6082-6085) re-uploaded at the next layer (engine.c:4988)
cb3_cb.first_later_consumer: next layer's mhc_pre encoder reading the residual (currently via CPU round trip)
cb3_cb.ownership_transfer: cb3 already writes buf_residual_gpu in place; the existing deferred-cb3 machinery (engine.c:4957-4972, gpu_residual_current) lets the next layer bind buf_residual_gpu directly — the readback is a pure round trip

routed_moe_kernel_or_cb.note: protocol requires no named removable dependency for this family; budget is the capped ROUTED_MOE_CB union

lm_head_top1.note: protocol requires no named removable dependency for this family

new_mhc_algorithm.note: frozen deterministic zero: no non-disturbing host-observable mHC-only interval exists inside the merged attention CB
